commonInstruction: Knowledge is optional reference material available through discover_knowledge and read_knowledge. Consult the suggested modules or other relevant topics only if useful for a decision, at any stage or proceed without reading it. Apply useful guidance without changing this brief. Do not ask questions or add explanatory text to the artwork.

development.prompt: Create an editable 640 by 480 px community notice for adults reading it on a screen. Include exactly this information: title 'Repair, Share and Learn Together'; date 'Saturday 24 October'; time '10 AM - 1 PM'; location 'Riverside Community Hall'; description 'Bring one small household item and learn practical repair skills with local volunteers.'; notice 'Spaces are limited. Children under 12 must attend with an adult.'; action 'Reserve a free place'. Use a warm cream background, dark blue and orange. Include all content, no images and no extra copy. Make it a useful finished notice.
criteria: Reading order makes event, attendance details and action identifiable
Related time/place and supporting notices are grouped distinctly
Actual-size supporting text is comfortably readable with balanced spacing
Action is findable without competing with event information

development.prompt: Design an editable 800 by 560 px documentation panel for a developer learning an API. Include title 'Create a document'; explanation 'Create an empty document before adding editable shapes. Keep the returned ID for later updates.'; code 'const document = await client.createDocument()'; actions 'Copy example', 'Try in sandbox', and 'Next: add shapes'; note 'Examples use the current API version.' Use a light neutral background with blue accents. Include all supplied copy, no invented content or illustrations. Make this a finished documentation layout.
criteria: Explanation and code remain the main reading hierarchy
Copy action is associated with the code rather than ambiguous distant content
Actions have distinguishable purposes without competing promotional emphasis
Actual-size code and supporting copy are legible with clear spacing
